# Swaption volatility cube: ir-vol-cube (IRV)

Normal (bp) swaption vols by expiry × tenor. One row per swaption volatility cube per business date, keyed by CUBE_ID. Read by the **market-data** pack's connector `market-store` (table `<root>/market/ir-vol-cube/`). Delivered **daily**, 60 business days (2026-07-08 to 2026-09-30): the first day's file is a **full snapshot** (7 records); the records never changed over the period, so every later day's file is empty. Drishti applies a day's file by key over the day before: a record absent from a day's file keeps its previous version, and nothing is ever deleted (an end is a changed status). 7 rows in all.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `data/testdata/market-data/ir-vol-cube/` + `changes-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz`, `snapshot-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl.gz` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line, gzip-compressed (`.jsonl.gz`) |
| Key field | `CUBE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the business date is the file's date (`snapshot-` or `changes-YYYY-MM-DD`), which becomes the lake's partition `business_date` |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | a full snapshot on the first day, then only the changed records |

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CUBE_ID` | string | required | The record's id (the business key) | pattern `^IRV-` | `"IRV-AUD"` |
| `CURRENCY` | string | required | The currency of the swaptions the cube prices, ISO 4217. | — | `"AUD"` |
| `MODEL` | string | required | The volatility model the quotes are in (Normal (Bachelier), SABR smile). | — | `"Normal (Bachelier), SABR smile"` |
| `V_1Y_10Y` | number | required | The 1-year into 10-year at-the-money swaption volatility: a normal volatility in basis points a year. | unit: bp (normal vol) | `137.22` |
| `V_5Y_5Y` | number | required | The 5-year into 5-year at-the-money swaption volatility: a normal volatility in basis points a year. | unit: bp (normal vol) | `132.72` |
| `GRID` | array of objects | required | The at-the-money swaption grid: one object per option expiry, shortest first, with a column per underlying swap tenor. | — | [7 objects] |
| `GRID[].EXPIRY` | string | required | The option expiry of the row (1M, 3M … 10Y). | one of `10Y`, `1M`, `1Y`, `2Y`, `3M`, `5Y`, `6M` | `"1M"` |
| `GRID[].T_1Y` | number | required | The volatility of the swaption on a 1-year swap: normal, basis points a year. | unit: bp (normal vol) | `148.55` |
| `GRID[].T_2Y` | number | required | The volatility of the swaption on a 2-year swap: normal, basis points a year. | unit: bp (normal vol) | `146.78` |
| `GRID[].T_5Y` | number | required | The volatility of the swaption on a 5-year swap: normal, basis points a year. | unit: bp (normal vol) | `143.74` |
| `GRID[].T_10Y` | number | required | The volatility of the swaption on a 10-year swap: normal, basis points a year. | unit: bp (normal vol) | `141.09` |
| `GRID[].T_30Y` | number | required | The volatility of the swaption on a 30-year swap: normal, basis points a year. | unit: bp (normal vol) | `136.56` |

## Fields in other rows

None: all 7 rows were read, and every field any of them has is in the record above.

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `CUBE_ID` per `business_date`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `CUBE_ID`, `CURRENCY`, `MODEL`, `V_1Y_10Y`, `V_5Y_5Y`, `GRID` (the contract's required fields).
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Each day: the records new or changed that day (or all of them); Drishti keeps the rest from the day before.
- Unique: `CUBE_ID` per business_date.
- `CUBE_ID` matches `^IRV-`.
